legal_tick.THE_CAVEAT_IS_MEASURED: every market record declares 0.01, uniformly across all coins and both months. The BOOK does not match it exactly: 342 of 4171076 resting levels (0.0082%) sit at 0.001 granularity, in 8 of 24 sampled windows -- and those windows declare 0.01 too. So the tick is the right ROUNDING grid and is NOT a guarantee that no finer price rests on the book.
legal_tick.what_may_be_frozen_on_this: bid rounds DOWN and ask rounds UP to 0.01. A quote on that grid is legal; it is not necessarily the best price available.

onchain_audit.the_audits_own_role: REPORTED, NOT ENFORCED (rule 14). This measures what the chain records; it promotes nothing and clears no gate.

WHY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: markets.jsonl carries NO fee field -- the market artifact does not state a fee at all
rewards_registry.jsonl is collected as a COUNT (recv_ns, n) and carries no fee rule, so the registry cannot supply one either
the on-chain audit measures what the chain RECORDS, and its own `role` says REPORTED, NOT ENFORCED -- it promotes nothing and clears no gate. A measurement of charges is not a market or account rule
and the measurement is NOT uniformly zero: 10 of 1056 maker legs WERE charged, all at price 0.99, so 'maker fills are free' is false as stated even as a description
maker_fee_rule.WHAT_SECTION_9_REQUIRES: the VERIFIED maker fee applicable to these markets; a zero fee only if the receipt identifies the SUPPORTING market/account rule
maker_fee_rule.THEREFORE: no fee may be frozen, and zero may NOT be assumed. A zero that no rule supports is an assumption wearing a number's clothes, and it would flatter every P&L computed from it. This is a FINDING: the input is unestablishable from what is collected, and `freeze_is_effective` stays False honestly rather than being satisfied by an assumption.
WHAT_WOULD_ESTABLISH_IT: the CLOB fee schedule for these condition ids, captured as an artifact with an as-of
or the account-level maker-rebate/fee tier that applies to the executing account, captured the same way
either one identifies a RULE; neither is currently collected

initial_inventory.units: signed shares of the UP token, per market
initial_inventory.why_zero: both arms must start from the SAME state (§5 gate 6, §9's 'identical external snapshot and starting state'), and any non-zero start is a position neither arm chose. It would be carried into P&L as settlement value under §9's 'remaining inventory valued at the official settlement outcome', crediting or debiting both arms for a trade neither made.
initial_inventory.where_it_currently_lives: de_fair_value_replay_seam.replay() reads `initial_state.get('inventory', 0.0)` -- a caller-supplied value with a permissive default. Freezing it here makes the default unnecessary rather than merely convenient.
initial_inventory.the_seam_already_enforces_sharing: initial_state is a field of ReplayInputs, so two arms starting from different inventories REFUSE REPLAY_ARMS_DO_NOT_SHARE_THEIR_INPUTS -- driven in gate 6's property cells

AN_UNESTABLISHABLE_INPUT_IS_A_FINDING: two of three are established from artifacts and one is not. The one that is not is reported as a finding with the evidence that proves it unestablishable, never filled in with a plausible default.
rule_10: every number here is computed from an artifact at run time
